intro: What the customer agreed to, the export of their data and anonymisation (law 18-07).

consent.title: Customer consents
consent.historyEmpty: No consent recorded for this customer.

exportHint: A data file (JSON, read by other software) and an Excel file, in the folder you choose.

anonymise.title: Anonymise this customer?
anonymise.body: Their name, phones, e-mail, address, NIN and notes will be erased for good, and their file archived.
anonymise.kept: What stays: the receipts and invoices (kept for the tax office), the legal registers, and the action log, which cannot be changed.

open.instalmentGuarantees: an instalment contract's documents (names, ID numbers, phones), kept with the contract
open.voucherBuyer: the buyer's name on a gift voucher

dpo.title: Data protection officer
dpo.intro: Named on the register of your use of personal data, which you keep for the ANPDP (the personal data protection authority).
dpo.name: Name
dpo.registerPrinted: Processing register sent to the printer.
dpo.accessReport: See the accesses to personal data
